economic_mechanism: Multi-hour directional pressure can persist when aggressive taker flow and order-book pressure align with an already-observed multi-hour price/volume trend; the economic payer is liquidity demand crossing spread and impact for immediacy.
payer: aggressive liquidity demand / informed taker flow
entry_event: entry-time aggressive trade-flow imbalance and L2 pressure aligned with closed-bar multi-hour OHLCV/volume momentum
direction_rule: continuation in the jointly observed flow and multi-hour momentum direction; symmetric long/short research scope
native_horizon: multi-hour to intraday; evaluator horizon must be frozen before first signal and may not be selected after outcomes
regime_owner: multi-hour trend with normal/non-jump volatility and complete fresh L2/trade-flow source; no-trade on stale source, jump/extreme-volatility state, or flow/momentum disagreement
invalidation: flow imbalance loses directional alignment or the closed-bar multi-hour momentum state flips before the frozen time stop
exit_logic: causal exit on predeclared flow/momentum invalidation or frozen time stop; no post-outcome adaptive extension
time_stop_rationale: bound exposure to the expected persistence horizon of directional liquidity demand rather than 5-minute scalp turnover
turnover_cost_budget: design target expected move >=2x verified round-trip cost; design prior only, never PASS evidence
falsification_rule: Kill the architecture if a fresh prospective frozen test fails positive net expectancy/PF/payoff after verified costs, fails matched direction/time/regime controls, or if its realized move budget does not materially dominate round-trip cost without destructive retention.
structural_signature: multi hour continuation conditioned on aggressive trade flow imbalance l2 pressure and closed bar participation momentum with jump volatility no trade regime
